text:
Stock-based consideration only: Company shareholders receive SPAC Common Stock at an Exchange Ratio, with Company Options and Company Restricted Stock Awards converted into SPAC stock or SPAC restricted stock; no cash consideration is described.
Per-share merger consideration comprises the right to receive SPAC Common Stock or SPAC Restricted Stock Award, with the per-share amount determined by the Exchange Ratio.
Exchange Ratio is defined as the quotient obtained by dividing (i) the Per Share Equity Value by ten dollars ($10.00); at the First Effective Time, each share of Company Common Stock will be exchanged for a number of SPAC Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio.
